bear_assumptions: USD 25 normalized forward EPS at 16x as expense growth, regulation, Reality Labs losses and poor AI-capex conversion compress margins and the valuation multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 30 normalized forward EPS at 20x as advertising remains durable, AI investment supports engagement and margins stabilize without restoring prior cash conversion.
bull_assumptions: USD 32 normalized forward EPS at 25x as AI materially improves monetization, messaging adds profit, capex productivity becomes visible and regulatory outcomes remain manageable.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh primary evidence and a current mark clear confidence-adjusted expected-return, base-upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin-of-safety, confidence and accepted-relationship gates while advertising growth, Family of Apps margins, AI monetization and per-share cash conversion remain supported; downgrade on sustained user or ad-pricing deterioration, margin compression without commensurate growth, persistently weak free cash flow, material dilution, unproductive capital spending, or legal and regulatory outcomes that impair targeting, distribution or monetization.
